unsupported: The company was founded by Dr. Ramy Tantawy, who serves as CEO, and Dr. Dale Shane Smith, who serves as president; both hold PhDs from The Ohio State University and bring decades of mixed-signal integrated circuit design experience from Intel, Micron Technology, and academic research.
As a fabless semiconductor provider, SenseICs designs and delivers turnkey integrated circuits and custom microelectronic solutions.
Prototyping and production leverage multi-project wafer runs through foundry partners such as SkyWater, GlobalFoundries, and Tower Semiconductor.
SenseICs serves defense and commercial markets.
Government customers include NASA, the U.S. Navy, Air Force, and Army Research Laboratory, as well as high-energy physics collaborations at CERN and Jefferson Lab.
Commercial applications target AI infrastructure, advanced medical devices, robotics, and autonomous vehicles.
The firm maintains close ties with The Ohio State University’s ElectroScience Laboratory and Nanotech West Lab.
The company’s stated mission is to deliver advanced turnkey ICs that drive next-generation sensors and systems for mission-critical applications.
Its STRIDE values — Staying Curious, Trust, Resilience, Innovation, Diversity, Excellence — reflect a culture built on multidisciplinary collaboration and proven technology validation.

Known for: Full turnkey integrated circuit design and custom microelectronic solutions for defense and commercial markets; Validated technology in High Dynamic Range ROICs, Tamper Resistant ICs, and Wide-band GaN Power Amplifiers; Partnerships with NASA, Navy, Air Force, ARL, CERN, and leading foundries (SkyWater, GlobalFoundries, Tower Semiconductor); Access to Ohio State University’s ElectroScience Laboratory and Nanotech West Lab for R&D
